name: pmf
description: Thirteen product-market fit skills that take a business from idea to launch in Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode: an adversarial pressure test, real market research, a simulated buyer panel, the offer and its price, unit economics, a real-world demand test with pre-set criteria, the smallest MVP with agentic coding discipline, marketing, brand, operations, the launch and the compiled plan.

interface.shortDescription: Product-market fit skills from idea to launch
interface.longDescription: Pressure test an idea, research the market with real sources, run a simulated buyer panel, build the offer and its price, do the unit economics, run a real-world demand test with pre-set criteria, build the smallest MVP with agentic coding discipline, plan marketing, brand, operations and launch, and compile a verdict from real evidence.
defaultPrompt: Run the pmf pack on my business idea.
